column2: Recovery module folder and boundary test
column3:
Feature: Recovery module folder and boundary test

  Background:
    Given the module map lists modules P1 to P10 and S1 to S9 with their packages
    Given the published packages are "<module>.api" and any other package the module map lists for each recovery module, and "..common.api.." for the common module

  Scenario: AC1 Boundary enforced
    Given a class "recovery.casewf.internal.SampleService" that imports "collection.internal.CollectorRepository"
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the boundary test fails the build
    Then the build log names boundary rule BND-1, "SampleService" and "CollectorRepository"

  Scenario: AC2 Published interface allowed
    Given a class "recovery.casewf.internal.SampleService" that calls an interface in "common.api"
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build passes

  Scenario: AC3 Recovery modules meet only through their api package
    Given a class in "recovery.integration.internal" that imports "recovery.decision.internal.DecisionLogRepository"
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build fails with boundary rule BND-3
    When the class imports the published "recovery.decision.writer.DecisionLogWriter" instead
    Then the build passes

  Scenario: AC4 A module uses only its own tables
    Given a class in "recovery.integration.internal" that uses the entity "recovery.casewf.internal.RecoveryCaseEntity"
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build fails with boundary rule BND-4

  Scenario: AC5 No direct call to a system of record
    Given a class in "recovery.casewf.internal" that uses "java.net.http.HttpClient"
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build fails with boundary rule BND-5
    Then the same use in "recovery.integration.adapter" passes

  Scenario: AC6 Front end boundary
    Given a component in "src/modules/recovery/caselist" that imports "src/modules/collection/worklist/WorkList"
    When the front end build runs
    Then it fails with rule no-collection-import

  Scenario: AC7 A package missing from the module map
    Given a new package "recovery.vendorx" not in the module map
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build fails with "package recovery.vendorx is not in the module map"

column2: Code owners for the recovery module
column3:
Feature: Code owners for the recovery module

  Background:
    Given the code owners file maps the recovery folders to "@scb-ace/techx-recovery-tech-leads" and the common module folder to "@scb-ace/ace-team"
    Given main requires one code owner approval and dismisses stale approvals

  Scenario: AC1 Review required
    Given a pull request that changes "ace-service/src/main/java/<ACE base path>/recovery/casewf/internal/AllocationService.java"
    When it is opened
    Then a TechX tech lead is required as reviewer
    Then an approval from a squad member outside the team leaves the merge blocked

  Scenario: AC2 A common module change needs the ACE team
    Given a pull request that changes a file under "ace-service/src/main/java/<ACE base path>/common/"
    When it is opened
    Then "@scb-ace/ace-team" is required as reviewer

  Scenario: AC3 A change across both modules needs both teams
    Given a pull request that changes one recovery file and one common module file
    When a TechX tech lead approves
    Then the merge stays blocked until a member of "@scb-ace/ace-team" also approves

  Scenario: AC4 Front end, migrations and the module map are covered
    Given a pull request that changes "ace-web/src/modules/recovery/caselist/CaseListPage.tsx", a file under "ace-service/src/main/resources/db/migration/recovery/" and "architecture/recovery-modules.yaml"
    When it is opened
    Then "@scb-ace/techx-recovery-tech-leads" is required for all three

  Scenario: AC5 An author cannot approve their own change
    Given a TechX tech lead opens a pull request on a recovery folder
    When the same tech lead approves it
    Then the merge stays blocked until a second member of the team approves

  Scenario: AC6 A new commit needs a new approval
    Given an approved pull request on a recovery folder
    When a new commit is pushed to it
    Then the system dismisses the approval and code owner review is required again

  Scenario: AC7 An owner that does not exist fails the check
    Given the code owners file names "@scb-ace/recovery-leads-typo" for a recovery path
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the code owners validation step fails and names the owner not found

column2: Types and contract tests from the API specification
column3:
Feature: Types and contract tests from the API specification

  Background:
    Given the build property rwb.release is "E1"
    Given operation getCasesCaseidTimers is first in E1 with capability Case record R

  Scenario: AC1 Types generated
    Given a change to the OpenAPI file that adds property "warnAt" to schema Timer
    When the build runs
    Then the generated server model and the front end type for Timer both hold "warnAt"
    Then the service and the front end compile against them

  Scenario: AC2 Contract broken
    Given the implementation of getCasesCaseidTimers returns "escalationLevel" as the text "two"
    When the contract tests run
    Then the build fails
    Then the report names getCasesCaseidTimers and the path "$[0].escalationLevel"

  Scenario: AC3 The specification is checked before generation
    Given an operation in the file with no x-capability
    When the build runs
    Then it fails at the lint step naming the operation

  Scenario: AC4 An undocumented status fails
    Given the implementation of getCasesCaseidTimers returns 400 for an unknown case
    Given the specification lists 200, 401, 403, 404 and 503 only
    When the contract tests run
    Then the build fails with "undocumented status 400" for getCasesCaseidTimers

  Scenario: AC5 A current operation with no implementation fails
    Given operation getAdminJobs is first in E1 and has no controller method
    When the build runs
    Then it fails with "getAdminJobs has no implementation"

  Scenario: AC6 A later operation is pending
    Given operation postQueuesQueueidPlacements is first in E2 and has no controller method
    When the build runs for release E1
    Then the build passes
    Then the report lists postQueuesQueueidPlacements as pending

  Scenario: AC7 The front end cannot use a removed field
    Given the file removes property "legalHold" from schema Case
    Given the case record screen reads "legalHold"
    When the front end build runs
    Then the type check fails naming the file and the line

  Scenario: AC8 An endpoint that skips its access check fails the build
    Given the implementation of getCasesCaseidTimers does not call the access check
    When the access tests run with role RW-REFADM, which holds no Case record right
    Then the operation answers 200
    Then the build fails with "access not enforced" for getCasesCaseidTimers

column2: Masked data in SIT and UAT
column3:
Feature: Masked data in SIT and UAT

  Background:
    Given masking rule version "MASK-2026.11" is in force
    Given extract "PII-SIT-20261120" for business date 2026-11-19 has a manifest with masking rule version "MASK-2026.11"
    Given the manifest lists 28,119 loan accounts: Mortgage 12,256, Hire purchase 12,960 and SSME 2,903, with total_balance sums per product

  Scenario: AC1 Masked copy
    Given a masked copy from the PII service
    When it is loaded into SIT
    Then every column tagged is_personal in party and contact_point holds a token or a masked value
    Then balances keep their shape: the count and the total_balance sum per product equal the manifest
    Then each party token joins to the same case_party and loan account rows as in the extract

  Scenario: AC2 A personal value left in the copy
    Given party row 4,512 of the extract holds a 13-digit value with a valid national ID check digit in id_no_token
    When the copy is loaded into SIT
    Then the system refuses the load in full with MSG-P1-002 and check "unmasked value in party.id_no_token"
    Then the previous SIT copy stays in use

  Scenario: AC3 Totals that do not match the manifest
    Given the loan_account file holds 28,118 rows
    When the copy is loaded into SIT
    Then the system refuses the load in full with MSG-P1-002 and check "Control totals loan_account 28,118 against 28,119"

  Scenario: AC4 A copy aimed at DEV
    Given the target environment is DEV
    When the masked copy load starts
    Then the system refuses it with MSG-P1-002 and check "masked copies load only into SIT and UAT"
    Then the system reads no file

  Scenario: AC5 The same extract twice
    Given extract "PII-SIT-20261120" was loaded into SIT on 2026-11-20
    When it is loaded into SIT again
    Then the system skips the load and the report names the load of 2026-11-20

  Scenario: AC6 A masking rule version that is not in force
    Given a manifest with masking rule version "MASK-2026.10"
    When the copy is loaded into UAT
    Then the system refuses the load in full with MSG-P1-002 and check "masking rule version MASK-2026.10 is not in force"

  Scenario: AC7 A second load while one runs
    Given a masked copy load into SIT is running
    When a second load into SIT starts
    Then the system refuses the second load with MSG-P2-006

Feature: Rule table test harness

  Background:
    Given the Restructure route set version "RES-2026.11" with 37 rows, R-RES-01 to R-RES-37
    Given a Tests sheet with one test case per row

  Scenario: AC1 Every row tested
    When the harness runs on "RES-2026.11"
    Then 37 tests run
    Then each test result names its rule ID and its test case ID
    Then all 37 pass and the version state is "VALIDATED"

  Scenario: AC2 Expected action differs
    Given the test case for "R-RES-04" expects to state "WITH_FCR_OFFICER" and owner role "RW-RESTRUCT"
    Given the row "R-RES-04" in version "RES-2026.12" has to state "IN_FCR_QUEUE"
    When the harness runs on "RES-2026.12"
    Then the test for "R-RES-04" fails with MSG-P3-014 naming the expected and the actual to state
    Then the version state is "FAILED"
    Then the version cannot be approved

  Scenario: AC3 Row with no test case
    Given version "RES-2026.13" where row "R-RES-12" names test case "RT-RES-012" that is not in the Tests sheet
    When the harness runs
    Then the system marks the version "FAILED" with MSG-P3-014 naming "R-RES-12" and "RT-RES-012"

  Scenario: AC4 Two rows hit one input
    Given version "RES-2026.14" where the conditions of "R-RES-09" and "R-RES-10" both hold for an offer outside the range with deviation_flag "Y"
    When the harness runs the test of "R-RES-10"
    Then the test fails with MSG-P3-014 naming "R-RES-09" and "R-RES-10"

  Scenario: AC5 No row hits
    Given version "RES-2026.15" where the condition of "R-RES-28" was changed so no row holds for a payment inside the cure period
    When the harness runs the test of "R-RES-28"
    Then the test fails with MSG-P3-014 naming "R-RES-28" as expected and no row hit

  Scenario: AC6 Missing fact
    Given the test case of "R-RES-30" gives no value for "break_count"
    When the harness runs it
    Then the test fails with MSG-P3-014 naming the fact "break_count"

  Scenario: AC7 Repeated run
    Given the harness ran on "RES-2026.11" with 37 passes
    When it runs again on "RES-2026.11"
    Then the results are the same 37 passes
    Then the system stores one result set for the version

  Scenario: AC8 Build pipeline
    Given the rule files in the repository hold the ten route sets with 448 rows
    When the build runs
    Then the build runs 448 rule tests named by rule ID
    Then a failing rule test fails the build

column2: Outbox and retry for outbound work
column3:
Feature: Outbox and retry for outbound work

  Background:
    Given consumer "win-dispatch" takes work request WIN_DISPATCH, holds the case step and has owner role RW-PLATADM
    Given consumers "ledger" and "reporting-feed" take CaseAllocated, CaseTransferred and CaseStateChanged, do not hold the case step and have owner role RW-PLATADM
    Given the retry settings are 3 retries at 1, 5 and 15 minutes after the previous attempt
    Given case "RW-2026-000601" has notice "NT-SYN-0601" waiting for approval

  Scenario: AC1 Sent after commit
    Given a notice approved
    When the transaction commits at 14 December 2026 10:00:00
    Then the outbox holds one WIN_DISPATCH request for case "RW-2026-000601" with one delivery for "win-dispatch"
    Then the header holds the event ID, idempotency key "WIN_DISPATCH:NT-SYN-0601", schema version 1, occurred time and actor
    Then the payload holds notice and case references only, with no name, address or identifier
    Then at the 10:01 run the sender delivers it and "win-dispatch" passes the notice to OutboundFiles.enqueue for the day's WIN file
    Then the delivery has status DELIVERED

  Scenario: AC2 Retry limit
    Given a target down for longer than the retry limit
    When "win-dispatch" fails at 10:01, 10:02, 10:07 and 10:22
    Then the system makes no fifth attempt
    Then the item moves to the exception queue: the "win-dispatch" delivery has status EXCEPTION and attempt count 4
    Then the system raises task RESOLVE_OUTBOX_DELIVERY on case "RW-2026-000601" for role RW-PLATADM
    Then event RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED moves the case to EXCEPTION_QUEUE by R-UNI-36 with one decision log entry

  Scenario: AC3 Nothing is sent for a change that did not commit
    Given the notice approval fails after OutboxWriter.publish and the transaction rolls back
    When the sender runs
    Then no event and no delivery exist for "NT-SYN-0601"

  Scenario: AC4 A retry that succeeds
    Given "win-dispatch" fails at 10:01 and the case moves to RETRY_QUEUE by R-UNI-33
    When the attempt at 10:02 succeeds
    Then the system delivers the delivery status with attempt count 2
    Then event RETRY_SUCCEEDED returns the case to the state it paused in by R-UNI-35

  Scenario: AC5 The same event is written once
    Given the approval of "NT-SYN-0601" is submitted twice with idempotency key "WIN_DISPATCH:NT-SYN-0601"
    When both transactions commit
    Then the outbox holds one event with that key
    Then the second transaction receives DuplicateOutboxKeyException and changes nothing

  Scenario: AC6 Two sender instances
    Given 200 due deliveries and two service instances
    When JOB-11 runs on both at 10:01
    Then the system makes each delivery once
    Then the delivery log holds 200 calls

  Scenario: AC7 Order per case and consumer
    Given event CaseTransferred with case sequence 11 and event CaseStateChanged with case sequence 12 for case "RW-2026-000601"
    Given the "ledger" consumer fails on sequence 11
    When the sender runs
    Then the system does not deliver sequence 12 to "ledger" until sequence 11 is DELIVERED

  Scenario: AC8 Consumers are independent
    Given event CaseAllocated for case "RW-2026-000601"
    When "ledger" fails and "reporting-feed" succeeds at 10:01
    Then the system delivers the "reporting-feed" delivery and the "ledger" delivery is RETRYING with next attempt 10:02
    Then the case route state does not change, because "ledger" does not hold the case step

  Scenario: AC9 Sending an exception delivery again
    Given delivery "OBD-SYN-0001" has status EXCEPTION
    When the platform administrator sends it again
    Then the response is 200 with message MSG-GEN-005
    Then the delivery status is PENDING with attempt count 0 and due at the next run
    When the platform administrator sends delivery "OBD-SYN-0002" with status DELIVERED again
    Then the response is 409 with message MSG-P2-022

  Scenario: AC10 An event with no case
    Given an event with no case whose only consumer fails 4 times
    When the retries are used
    Then the delivery status is EXCEPTION
    Then the system sends an alert to the platform administrator within 15 minutes
    Then no task and no case event are raised

  Scenario: AC11 Retry settings come from configuration
    Given the retry delays are changed in the configuration service to 2, 10 and 30 minutes at 09:00
    When "ledger" fails at 10:01
    Then the next attempt is due at 10:03

Feature: Scheduled jobs on Quartz

  Background:
    Given two service instances "ACE-1" and "ACE-2" share the clustered Quartz job store
    Given the COLLINS load for business date 2026-12-02 passed its checks at 05:20 and JOB-02 succeeded at 05:50

  Scenario: AC1 Runs once
    When the morning allocation is due for business date 2026-12-02
    Then JOB-03 runs once, on one of the two instances
    Then the system logs its run with job "JOB-03", business date 2026-12-02, instance, start, end, status "SUCCEEDED" and the case counts

  Scenario: AC2 Missed run
    Given both instances were down from 04:30 to 09:40 on 2026-12-02
    When the service restarts at 09:40
    Then JOB-03 and JOB-04 run for business date 2026-12-02 after JOB-02 succeeds for that date
    Then the system logs each run with MSG-P3-030 naming the job and 2026-12-02

  Scenario: AC3 Repeated run for the same date
    Given JOB-03 succeeded for business date 2026-12-02
    When JOB-03 is fired again for 2026-12-02
    Then the system allocates no case again
    Then the run log records a skip for JOB-03 and 2026-12-02

  Scenario: AC4 Timer check does not overlap
    Given a JOB-05 run that started at 10:00 takes 7 minutes
    When the 10:05 fire is due
    Then the 10:05 run starts only after the 10:00 run ends
    Then no two JOB-05 runs are in progress at the same time

  Scenario: AC5 Several missed dates
    Given COLLINS loads passed for business dates 2026-12-02, 2026-12-03 and 2026-12-04 while both instances were down
    When the service restarts on 2026-12-04 at 11:00
    Then JOB-03 runs for 2026-12-02, then 2026-12-03, then 2026-12-04
    Then the system logs each run with its business date

  Scenario: AC6 More missed dates than the limit
    Given 7 business dates with passed COLLINS loads and no JOB-03 run
    When the service restarts
    Then no automatic catch-up run starts
    Then an alert with MSG-P3-031 names JOB-03 and the 7 dates

  Scenario: AC7 Dependency not met
    Given JOB-02 failed for business date 2026-12-03
    When JOB-03 is due for 2026-12-03
    Then JOB-03 does not run and its run is recorded "WAITING" with MSG-P3-031 naming "JOB-02"
    Then when JOB-02 succeeds for 2026-12-03 at 08:10 JOB-03 runs for 2026-12-03

  Scenario: AC8 Instance stops part way
    Given JOB-04 is running for 2026-12-02 on "ACE-1"
    When "ACE-1" stops
    Then "ACE-2" runs JOB-04 again for 2026-12-02 within the cluster check-in interval of 20 seconds
    Then the run log shows one "FAILED" run on "ACE-1" and one "SUCCEEDED" run on "ACE-2"

  Scenario: AC9 Allocation late
    Given JOB-03 for 2026-12-02 has not succeeded at 07:00
    When the deadline check runs at 07:00
    Then an alert with MSG-P3-031 naming JOB-03, 2026-12-02 and 07:00 reaches the operations channel by 07:15

  Scenario: AC10 Run book for every job
    Given the run book folder holds run books for JOB-03 and JOB-05 only
    When the build runs
    Then the build fails naming JOB-04

Feature: Decision log hash chain check

  Background:
    Given the environment is SIT with the synthetic decision log
    Given JOB-13 for business date 2 December 2026 ended at 01:40 on 3 December 2026

  Scenario: AC1 Chain intact
    Given the decision log holds 48,210 entries and none has been changed
    When JOB-14 runs at 02:00 on 3 December 2026
    Then the job run record shows type "JOB-14", business date 2 December 2026, status "COMPLETED" and result "INTACT"
    Then its checks hold entries checked 48,210, last chain_seq 48,210 and that entry's entry_hash
    Then MSG-P7-007 with the count and the last hash is sent to the Compliance group

  Scenario: AC2 Break
    Given the actions of the entry with chain_seq 30,005 were changed in the SIT database with the trigger disabled
    When JOB-14 runs
    Then the run result is "BROKEN" with first break chain_seq 30,005 and its entry ID
    Then the system raises an incident and MSG-P7-008 with the entry ID is sent to the Compliance group before 08:00 on 3 December 2026

  Scenario: AC3 A run that stops is reported
    Given the database connection is closed in the test double after 20,000 entries
    When JOB-14 runs
    Then the run status is "FAILED" with entries checked 20,000
    Then the system alerts the platform administrator group
    Then the system sends MSG-P7-013 to the Compliance group with the date of the last complete check, 2 December 2026

  Scenario: AC4 A rerun gives a new record and no second scheduled run
    Given JOB-14 for business date 2 December 2026 failed at 02:20
    When test user "U-9301" holding RW-PLATADM reruns it from the job monitor at 08:30
    Then a second run record for business date 2 December 2026 is written with rerun true
    Then the system marks the report to Compliance as a rerun
    Then while the rerun is running a second start of JOB-14 is refused by the scheduler

  Scenario: AC5 An empty log is intact
    Given the decision log holds no entry
    When JOB-14 runs
    Then the result is "INTACT" with entries checked 0 and last hash of 64 zeros

  Scenario: AC6 The job waits for the decision log copy
    Given JOB-13 for business date 2 December 2026 is still running at 02:00 and ends at 02:25
    When JOB-14 fires at 02:00
    Then it starts the check at 02:25 and records the JOB-13 end time
    Then if JOB-13 has not ended by 04:00 the check starts at 04:00 with the note "JOB-13 not ended"

  Scenario: AC7 Several changed entries
    Given the entries with chain_seq 12,001 and 40,350 were changed in the SIT database
    When JOB-14 runs
    Then the first break is chain_seq 12,001 and the failing count is 2
    Then one incident and one MSG-P7-008 report name both entry IDs

  Scenario: AC8 Entries written during the run
    Given the log holds 48,210 entries when JOB-14 starts
    Given 37 entries are appended while it runs
    When the run ends
    Then entries checked is 48,210 and last chain_seq is 48,210
    Then the next night's run checks 48,247 entries

Feature: Performance test harness

  Background:
    Given SIT holds 23,612 open cases from the masked copy
    Given the mix file version "MIX-2026.12" weights getCases 30, getCasesCaseid 25, getCasesCaseidTimeline 15, getCasesCaseidInteractions 10, getQueuesQueueidCases 10, getCasesCaseidDocuments 5 and postCasesCaseidInteractions 5

  Scenario: AC1 Busiest hour
    Given 410 simulated users at three requests a minute
    When the test runs in SIT for a 60 minute steady period
    Then the system makes about 73,800 requests in the steady period
    Then screens respond under 2 seconds at the 95th percentile for each of the 7 operations
    Then the stage passes and the report is attached to the release record with the build ID

  Scenario: AC2 The 2 second boundary
    Given a result where getCasesCaseidTimeline has a 95th percentile of 2,000 ms and every other operation is under 1,500 ms
    When the gate evaluates it
    Then the stage fails and the report names getCasesCaseidTimeline
    When the result shows 1,999 ms for getCasesCaseidTimeline
    Then the stage passes

  Scenario: AC3 Error rate above the limit
    Given a result with 74,000 requests of which 740 returned 5xx
    When the gate evaluates it
    Then the stage fails with error rate 1.0 percent

  Scenario: AC4 Too little data
    Given SIT holds 9,800 open cases
    When the stage starts
    Then the system refuses the run before any load
    Then the report states "data volume below the test base: 9,800 of 23,600"

  Scenario: AC5 One run at a time
    Given a run holds the SIT lock
    When a second run starts
    Then the system refuses it with "run already in progress" and the first run continues

  Scenario: AC6 A repeated run for the same build
    Given build "2026.12.18-04" failed the stage at 10:00
    When the stage is run again at 14:00 and passes
    Then the system attaches both reports to the release record
    Then the gate shows passed from the 14:00 run

  Scenario: AC7 The mix comes from the data file
    Given the mix file version "MIX-2026.12b" sets getCasesCaseidTimeline to 25 and getCases to 20
    When the next run completes
    Then about 25 percent of steady requests are getCasesCaseidTimeline
    Then the report names mix file version "MIX-2026.12b"

Feature: Browser and accessibility tests

  Background:
    Given browsers.json lists Chrome N, Chrome N-1, Edge N and Edge N-1, where N is the current major version in the runner image
    Given the screen list holds SCR-02, SCR-03, SCR-04, SCR-05, SCR-07 and SCR-09

  Scenario: AC1 Accessibility
    Given the case record screen SCR-03 for case "RW-2026-000701" in state Read only
    When the scan runs in English and in Thai
    Then the system finds no WCAG 2.1 AA error

  Scenario: AC2 Every main screen is scanned
    When the browser stage runs
    Then the system scans each of the 6 screens in each of its listed states in English and in Thai
    Then the report lists 6 screens with their states and zero violations

  Scenario: AC3 The bank's browsers
    Given the case list SCR-02 renders a column header off screen in Edge N-1 only
    When the functional tests run
    Then the stage fails and the report names SCR-02, Edge N-1 and the failed check

  Scenario: AC4 A violation fails the build
    Given a change that removes the accessible name from the Extract button on SCR-02
    When the scan runs
    Then the stage fails
    Then the report names SCR-02, state List, rule "button-name" and the element

  Scenario: AC5 A missing browser
    Given the runner image has no Chrome N-1
    When the stage starts
    Then it fails with "browser not available: Chrome N-1" before any test runs

  Scenario: AC6 An expired exception
    Given the exception list excuses rule "color-contrast" on SCR-07 until 31 December 2026
    When the stage runs on 4 January 2027 and the violation is still present
    Then the stage fails with "exception expired" for SCR-07

  Scenario: AC7 Labels in Thai and English
    Given SCR-05 shows the raw key "transfer.reason.label" in Thai
    When the scan runs in Thai
    Then the stage fails with "missing label" for SCR-05

  Scenario: AC8 Keyboard access
    Given the Save action on SCR-05 cannot receive focus by the Tab key
    When the keyboard test runs
    Then the stage fails with "keyboard access" for SCR-05 action Save

  Scenario: AC9 A flaky test
    Given the SCR-04 filter test fails on its first run and passes on its retry
    When the stage completes
    Then the stage passes
    Then the report lists the SCR-04 filter test as flaky

column2: PDPA lint for code, tests and logs
column3:
Feature: PDPA lint for code, tests and logs

  Background:
    Given the data dictionary marks first_name, last_name, cif_no, id_no_token, date_of_birth, value_token, summary and field_value as personal

  Scenario: AC1 Log statement
    Given a log statement in "recovery.casewf.internal.SampleService" that writes party.getFirstName()
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the PDPA lint fails the build
    Then the build log names rule PDPA-LOG-FIELD, the file, the line and field first_name, and does not print a value

  Scenario: AC2 A whole entity in a log
    Given a log statement that writes the object "party" of type PartyEntity
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build fails with rule PDPA-LOG-ENTITY

  Scenario: AC3 A national identifier in a fixture
    Given a JSON fixture whose "idNoToken" holds a 13-digit number with a valid check digit, generated by the test at run time
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build fails with rule PDPA-FIXTURE-ID

  Scenario: AC4 A personal field without the synthetic prefix
    Given a SQL seed that sets last_name to "TESTNAME"
    When the pipeline runs
    Then the build fails with rule PDPA-FIXTURE-FIELD
    Then the same seed with last_name "SYN-LAST-0001" passes

  Scenario: AC5 A field newly marked personal
    Given the dictionary marks loan_account.contract_no as personal in a new version
